issues.quote: **Cleared by** a console reply or call, CRM activity where we read it, or one click ("Handled elsewhere", "No reply needed"), logged with actor and time.
issues.concern: My guys keep two VinSolutions tabs open and text from there. Your own risks table says CRM activity is read nowhere today. So at launch every reply sent from VinSolutions or a cell phone stays 'unanswered' until the rep comes back to your console and clicks. That is the extra step the dealer already told you these guys will not take, and when they skip it the escalation texts my sales manager about customers who were answered an hour ago. He mutes it in a week and the queue is dead.
issues.because: E10, E13; Risks table row 'CRM activity in, console replies out | unknown [Q18]'
issues.ask: Tie the per-rooftop switch-on to where reps actually reply: turn escalation texts on only at rooftops where CRM activity is read or the rooftop confirms its reps reply from the console. Elsewhere ship the queue without escalation. Add a pilot check: the share of items cleared by 'Handled elsewhere'. If it is high, the queue is a to-do list of work already done.

issues.quote: **Mine** is the CRM's assigned salesperson (sales) or the scheduler or DMS advisor (service), read CRM/DMS-first; never Spyne's round-robin pick or a takeover claimant [PM] [E43].
issues.concern: I accept that the CRM owner is the owner. But not every salesperson or advisor in my CRM has a console seat; he is adding two right now. If the owner in VinSolutions has no console login, or the lead gets reassigned in the CRM and you have not picked it up yet, the customer sits in 'mine' for someone who will never see it. The escalation catches it eventually, but only after the customer has already waited.
issues.ask: Name the CRM/DMS-user-to-console-member mapping as a dependency. State that a waiting customer whose owner has no console seat, or no mapping, goes straight to the team view. Give the manager view a count of unmapped owners. Say how quickly a CRM reassignment shows up in 'mine'.

issues.quote: unknown; baseline from reply events shipped before the UI
issues.concern: This is the only number I can take to the dealer principal, and it is soft in two ways. The before number misses every reply my reps already send from VinSolutions, so 'before' looks worse than it was. The after number counts a 'No reply needed' click as an answer, so a rep can clear his queue without talking to anyone. Either way the hours come down on paper and the customer waits just as long.
issues.ask: Define the measure: median hours from customer message to the first human reply, and the share answered within one business hour, per department. Count clicks separately, not as replies. Show in the manager view the share each owner cleared by click. At rooftops where CRM activity is not read, state that the baseline undercounts replies.

issues.quote: | Manager cross-checking time | unknown | one view per owner | [E6] |
issues.concern: 'One view per owner' is a screen, not a saving. This is the second line you put on my statement, as manager time, and nothing here measures it.
issues.ask: Either name how it is measured (for example, how many screens the used car manager has open at this rooftop before and 30 days after, per E13) or drop the row and keep the hours claim alone.
